targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() as time, COUNT(*) as value FROM taxi_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT NOW() as time, SUM(total_amount) as value FROM taxi_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT NOW() as time, AVG(distance_miles) as value FROM taxi_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT NOW() as time, AVG(tip_amount) as value FROM taxi_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Nombre de trips" FROM taxi_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 📍 Top Zones de Prise en Charge

targets.rawSql: SELECT pickup_zone AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM taxi_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY pickup_zone ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT payment_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM taxi_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY payment_type
SELECT total_amount FROM taxi_events WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND total_amount > 0 AND total_amount < 100

SELECT ingested_at AS "Heure", pickup_zone AS "Prise en charge", dropoff_zone AS "Destination", ROUND(distance_miles::numeric,2) AS "Distance (mi)", total_amount AS "Tarif ($)", payment_type AS "Paiement" FROM taxi_events ORDER BY ingested_at DESC LIMIT 15
